preconditions.name: enough_divergent_seeds
preconditions.description: the number of seeds whose candidate pool is DIVERGENT on the focus C1 comparison arms (A0 + A2 settling + ARM_NOISE) is >= MIN_DIVERGENT_SEEDS. Per-seed-divergent gating (701a-style): a degenerate cell self-excludes. Too few divergent seeds => substrate_not_ready_requeue (pool too collapsed to test conversion).
preconditions.control: consumed cand_world_summary pairwise spread > floor (GAP-A); per-seed

preconditions.name: matched_noise_control_verified_lifting
preconditions.description: HARNESS FIX 1: the ARM_NOISE matched-noise temperature control (re-tuned NOISE_FLOOR_ALPHA 1.0 -> 2.0) lifts committed-class entropy strict-above A0 by margin on a strict-majority of DIVERGENT seeds -- the 569g/684 lesson: a non-lifting noise control is an UNVERIFIED bar (C1 would be trivially satisfiable). Control not verify-lifting => substrate_not_ready_requeue (re-tune the noise alpha).
preconditions.control: ARM_NOISE committed-class entropy vs A0, divergent seeds, paired

preconditions.name: delta_t_carries_variance_on_learning_arms
preconditions.description: the signed-RPE delta_t (= benefit_eval - harm_eval - V-hat_t; OR the unsigned abs ARC-016 variance on C3_SETTLING_UNSIGNED) carries cross-tick STD above floor on a majority of seeds on the settling-armed (A2, A3, C3) arms AND the w_chan-armed (A3) arm -- there is outcome variance to learn from. Flat => substrate_not_ready_requeue (the C3 unsigned arm flat is STARVED, not 'unsigned fails').
preconditions.control: wlat_delta_t_std (A2/A3/C3) + lcg_delta_t_std (A3) on the armed arms

preconditions.name: learned_weights_moved_from_init_on_armed_arms
preconditions.description: W_lat range > floor AND the settling MOVED the field (learned_settling_round_delta > floor) on the settling-armed arms (A2, A3, C3; zero init => range 0) AND w_chan range > floor on the w_chan-armed arm (A3; softplus-unity init => range 0). Weights never moving => eligibility never credited => substrate_not_ready_requeue.

preconditions.name: candidate_pool_divergent_focus_arms
preconditions.description: consumed cand_world_summaries (e2.world_forward) per-candidate SPREAD clears the floor on a majority of seeds in the focus arms (GAP-A non-vacuity). This is the per-seed divergence the gating reads.
preconditions.control: SD-056 e2 trained online in P0; candidate_summary_source=e2_world_forward

c3_folds_700a: V3-EXQ-700b folds the V3-EXQ-700a C3 signed-vs-unsigned-RPE ablation onto the CONVERTING (settling) lever as C3_SETTLING_UNSIGNED. Both 700 and 700a are superseded by this test-design-fixed harness; mark both manifests evidence_direction=superseded at governance review.
evidence_direction_note: V3-EXQ-700b ARC-108 sec-7 LEARNED-GATING CONVERSION FALSIFIER, TEST-DESIGN-FIXED RE-RUN (experiment_purpose=evidence; claim_ids=[MECH-439, ARC-108, MECH-450]; supersedes V3-EXQ-700, folds the V3-EXQ-700a C3 arm). Routed by the confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-700-cluster_2026-06-23 (a BRITTLE TEST HARNESS, not the claims). FULL HARNESS FIX: (1) VERIFIED-LIFTING matched-noise bar (re-tuned NOISE_FLOOR_ALPHA 1.0 -> 2.0, kept as a precondition); (2) PER-SEED-DIVERGENT gating (701a-style: interpret C1/C2/C3 + the noise bar ONLY on seeds whose pool is divergent, so a degenerate cell self-excludes); (3) 6 seeds; (4) FOCUS the MECH-450 W_lat settling arm (drop the w_chan-only A1 that lifted below noise on 700); (5) FOLD IN C3 (learned_channel_rpe_mode signed|unsigned) onto the settling lever. PRIMARY DV = committed-action-class entropy. The landed arithmetic envelope (use_f_eligibility_demotion + adaptive_floor 689e + go_nogo 689g + modulatory-authority/top_k k=3 569i) is a MATCHED CONSTANT on all arms exactly as V3-EXQ-699/700; use_differentiable_cem=False (SD-055 safety note). DECISIVE-OR-ESCALATE: a preconditions-met no-lift FAIL on the NOW-VERIFIED bar routes to the V4 full BG-thalamo-cortical loop / loop-segregation scope bet (no_lift_preconditions_met_escalate_v4_full_loop), NOT another V3 letter; a precondition-unmet outcome self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue. RE-DERIVE BRAKE EXEMPT (user-adjudicated 2026-06-23; substrate enriched + new mechanism + test-design fix). PROMOTES NOTHING until it scores (MECH-439 substrate_ceiling; ARC-108/MECH-450 substrate_conditional; pending_retest_after_substrate). outcome=FAIL; label=substrate_not_ready_requeue; per_claim={'MECH-439': 'non_contributory', 'ARC-108': 'non_contributory', 'MECH-450': 'non_contributory'}.

config_summary.arms: A0_ENVELOPE_ONLY / A2_SETTLING_SIGNED (W_lat, focus) / A3_BOTH_SIGNED (w_chan+W_lat) / C3_SETTLING_UNSIGNED (B5 ablation) / ARM_NOISE

config_summary.matched_diversity_stack: MECH-341 stratified + use_dacc (MECH-260 perseveration No-Go feed) + use_gated_policy + use_lateral_pfc_analog (lateral_pfc_train_rule_bias_head=True, TRAINED in P1 REINFORCE) + SD-056 all levers + the matured/maintained CRF pool + use_candidate_rule_field
config_summary.primary_dv: committed-action-class entropy (nats), interpreted on divergent seeds only
config_summary.phases: P0 e2-train (CRF matures, learned gating ON) -> P1 frozen-encoder bias-head REINFORCE -> P2 e2+bias frozen, learned gating KEEPS adapting (binned first/second half for C2)

interpretation_grid.PASS_learned_gating_converts_where_arith: preconditions met (ENOUGH divergent seeds + VERIFIED-LIFTING noise bar + learning engaged) AND C1 (a settling arm committed-class entropy strict-above BOTH A0 and the verified noise control on a strict-majority of DIVERGENT seeds) AND C2 (the lift GROWS over training + the learned weights moved). The learned recurrent settling step (MECH-450 W_lat) -- and/or the learned channel re-weighting (ARC-108 w_chan via A3) -- CONVERTS committed-action diversity where the pure-arithmetic envelope plateaus -> supports MECH-439 (ceiling liftable) + the learning claim(s). C3 (signed-RPE load-bearing): if C3a (signed settling converts) AND C3b (unsigned settling fails) with the unsigned arm engaged, the SIGN of the RPE is load-bearing -> ARC-108 supports; if the unsigned arm ALSO converts, route back to ARC-016 (ARC-108 mixed). PROMOTES NOTHING here (substrate_ceiling / substrate_conditional).
interpretation_grid.PASS_static_reweighting_fold_into_arithm: preconditions met AND C1 (converts) BUT NOT C2 (the lift is present from tick 0 and does NOT grow with training). The conversion is a STATIC re-weighting, not learning -> MECH-439 supports (ceiling liftable) but ARC-108 / MECH-450 are MIXED; fold the winning static weights into the arithmetic lever, do NOT mint a learning claim.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_no_lift_preconditions_met_escalate_: DECISIVE. preconditions met (learning engaged, weights moved, ENOUGH divergent seeds, noise control VERIFIED-LIFTING) BUT NO entropy lift over A0/noise on the settling arms. The genuine 'no lift' outcome on a NOW-VERIFIED bar + per-seed-divergent gating -> the single collapsed arena is the binding constraint -> escalate to the V4 full BG-thalamo-cortical loop / loop-segregation (design sec 6), NOT another V3 letter. This is NOT a falsification of ARC-107 (the arithmetic envelope still holds) and does NOT promote learned gating. non_contributory for all claims.
interpretation_grid.FAIL_substrate_not_ready_requeue: a precondition is unmet: too FEW divergent seeds (pool collapsed), OR delta_t flat (no outcome variance), OR the learned weights never moved (eligibility never credited) / the settling never moved the field, OR the matched-noise control did not VERIFY-LIFT above A0 on a strict-majority of divergent seeds (unverified bar -- re-tune NOISE_FLOOR_ALPHA). The conversion question could NOT be measured -- NOT a falsification. Re-queue at an adequate substrate.
